scope: Final source-frozen test run; GUI and Python gates remain separate.
Initial fresh-extension suite: two test-harness assumptions failed (dimensionSets expectation support and UNSET optional row_places); preserved as a failed stage.
Fresh-extension full366 Python tests passed after only the two harness assumptions were corrected. Does not validate the subsequent server-only stale-geometry fix.
One real API health unit test; no database needed. Other API integration targets had zero selected tests (96 filtered in total), so this is not a full API suite.
Real PostGIS seven-test target failed on a test expectation: ideal angle versus actual stored face direction at large coordinates. Production tolerance was unchanged; failed log retained.

Real PostGIS full seven-test dimension-set guard target. Same-recipe stale source geometry, opening membership, rotated/right-face/centre and large-coordinate caches, plot-scale cache and v1 idempotency covered.
Both desktop command fixture runners passed after the query setup fixture local-slot correction;271 unrelated tests filtered.
Failed strict lint gate: three new source-key expect calls, cache event expect and map_entry. Rules were not relaxed; later fixes require another strict run.
